svg.aria-label: Sealed Exploit — A tamper-taped evidence bag, still sealed, stamped PAID in green; the receipt beneath carries the tx hash. An OutLayer TEE runs the sealed exploit; the keyless pool pays the first valid break or refuses with a reason.

g.text: The protocol receives the exploit only once the money is owed.
NO KEY CAN PULL A RESERVED PAYOUT
NEAR global contract · OutLayer TEE · revm · Rust/WASI · USDC
